title: Unit Schematic
description: A complete unit definition for the Child of Light game engine. Declares physical inputs; gameplay stats (speed, range, damage, cooldown) are derived by the engine from these inputs through the equations in physics.md.

id.description: Unique identifier within the Schematic namespace. Lowercase with hyphens or underscores.

physics_version.description: The Physics Constitution version this unit resolves against (per the Invariance rule). Old units keep their original version forever.

faction.description: Faction affinity. Earth-faction units are restricted by faction tech. Returner units are V2+.

designer.description: Salvage Signature — the original designer's name. Carries forward through every derivative and salvage. Use STARTER_KIT for the base game's stock units.

engine_kW.description: Primary engine output in kilowatts. 0 acceptable for static structures.

drivetrain_efficiency.description: Fraction of engine output that reaches motion (0-1). Real values: tracked vehicles ~0.6-0.75; wheeled ~0.75-0.85; legged ~0.4-0.6.

fuel_consumption_rate_MJs.description: Fuel burn at full engine power. Cruise consumption is approximately 40-60% of this.

compatibility_tags.description: Capability tags. Determine which environments the unit can enter.

thermal_capacity_MJ.description: Chassis-level thermal mass for heat sinking (separate from per-weapon heat budgets).

voxel_data.description: Optional voxel chassis data sculpted in the Editor App. Format TBD; placeholder for now.

structure_type.description: Subtype for static_structure and static_wall chassis. Governs placement rules and upgrade chains in the game engine.

hardpoints.description: Named weapon/module slots. Each slot has an ID and a type that constrains which weapon platform can be mounted. For mobile units, prefer bare hardpoint_count. For structures, use this array for full slot identity.

id.description: Unique slot name within this unit (e.g. 'main_gun', 'aux_1', 'gate_north')

type.description: Slot class — constrains which part types can mount here

occupied_by.description: Part schematic ID currently mounted in this slot. Omit for empty slot.

parts.description: Mounted parts. Each occupies one hardpoint. May exceed hardpoint_count only for built-in components.

costs.description: Build cost per resource. Power is per-tick streaming cost; others are one-time stockpile cost.

tech_requirements.description: IDs of tech nodes that must be researched before this unit can be built.

evolution.description: Successor Schematics this unit can evolve into under specific conditions.

mesh_asset.description: Reference to the visual mesh this unit uses, so the editor can reload it on open. Either a built-in template or an imported file path.

rig.description: Moving-part definitions. Each entry rigs a named mesh node for motion: passive (auto-spin/roll), reactive (aim within yaw/pitch constraint arcs), or active (animation state machine). Recoil is derived from weapon physics, never authored here.

id.description: Unique rig id within the unit (e.g. 'main_turret', 'barrel').

target_node.description: Name of the mesh node / sub-object this rig moves.

pivot.description: Local pivot point [x,y,z] the node rotates about. Defaults to the node's bounding-box centre when omitted.

yaw.description: Horizontal traverse constraint (rotation about the up axis).

parent_rig.description: Optional id of a parent rig whose motion this one composes onto (e.g. a barrel's parent_rig is the turret).

role.description: Tactical role. Used by the game AI for squad composition and target priority.
